/-! Exact positive null-frequency coordinate on each regular massless
rapidity fiber. The invariant measure is du/u, proved by change of variables.
This is a measure identity, not a modular-charge assertion. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1400000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.NullFrequency
open Set MeasureTheory
open ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016
open scoped ENNReal

def frequency (r x : ℝ) : ℝ := r*Real.exp (-x)

theorem frequency_pos (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) (x : ℝ) : 0<frequency r x :=
  mul_pos hr (Real.exp_pos _)

theorem frequency_hasDerivAt (r x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (frequency r) (-frequency r x) x := by
  unfold frequency
  convert! (((Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-x)).comp x (hasDerivAt_id x).neg).const_mul r) using 1 <;> simp

theorem frequency_injective (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) : Function.Injective (frequency r) := by
  intro x y h
  have he:Real.exp (-x)=Real.exp (-y):=mul_left_cancel₀ hr.ne' h
  exact neg_injective (Real.exp_injective he)

theorem frequency_image (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) : frequency r '' (univ:Set ℝ)=Ioi 0 := by
  ext u
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,_,rfl⟩
    exact frequency_pos r hr x
  · intro hu
    refine ⟨-Real.log (u/r),mem_univ _,?_⟩
    simp only [frequency,neg_neg,Real.exp_log (div_pos hu hr)]
    field_simp

theorem frequency_is_shell_null (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) (x : ℝ) :
    energy r (longitudinal r x)-longitudinal r x=frequency r x := by
  rw [energy_longitudinal r hr x]
  unfold longitudinal frequency
  rw [←mul_sub,Real.cosh_sub_sinh]

theorem frequency_lintegral (r : ℝ) (hr : 0<r) (g : ℝ→ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻u in Ioi 0,ENNReal.ofReal (1/u)*g u)=∫⁻x,g (frequency r x) := by
  have hc:=lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul
    (s:=(univ:Set ℝ)) MeasurableSet.univ
    (fun x _=>(frequency_hasDerivAt r x).hasDerivWithinAt)
    (frequency_injective r hr).injOn (fun u=>ENNReal.ofReal (1/u)*g u)
  rw [frequency_image r hr,Measure.restrict_univ] at hc
  rw [hc]
  apply lintegral_congr_ae
  apply ae_of_all
  intro x
  change ENNReal.ofReal (|-frequency r x|)*(ENNReal.ofReal (1/frequency r x)*g (frequency r x))=g (frequency r x)
  rw [←mul_assoc,abs_neg,abs_of_pos (frequency_pos r hr x),
    ←ENNReal.ofReal_mul (frequency_pos r hr x).le]
  have he:frequency r x*(1/frequency r x)=1:=by field_simp [(frequency_pos r hr x).ne']
  rw [he,ENNReal.ofReal_one,one_mul]

end F1Fecho.NullFrequency
#print axioms F1Fecho.NullFrequency.frequency_hasDerivAt
#print axioms F1Fecho.NullFrequency.frequency_is_shell_null
#print axioms F1Fecho.NullFrequency.frequency_lintegral

/-! The exact null contraction of Maxwell stress and its transverse screen
amplitudes. Algebra only; the null-plane integral is a separate consumer. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal
open Matrix F1Fecho.MaxwellStress ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016

def shellNullFrequency (y : MomentumCoordinates) : ℝ := shellEnergy y-y.2
def nullPolarization (y : MomentumCoordinates) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ :=
  !![-transverseRatio y 0,transverseRatio y 1;
    -transverseRatio y 1,-transverseRatio y 0]

theorem shellNullFrequency_pos (y : MomentumCoordinates) (hy : y.1≠0) :
    0<shellNullFrequency y := by
  have hr:=transverseMass_pos_of_ne_zero 0 y.1 hy
  have hs:=shellEnergy_sq y
  have hn:=shellEnergy_nonneg y
  unfold shellNullFrequency
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg y.2, transverseMass_sq 0 y.1, sq_pos_of_pos hr]

theorem nullPolarization_orthogonal (y : MomentumCoordinates) (hy : y.1≠0) :
    (nullPolarization y).transpose*nullPolarization y=1 := by
  have h:=transverseRatio_sq_sum y hy
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [nullPolarization,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_two,Matrix.transpose_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply] <;> nlinarith

theorem null_strength_factor (y : MomentumCoordinates) (a j : Fin 2) :
    -(cartesianStrength y j 0 (show Fin 4 from ⟨a.val+2,by omega⟩))+
      cartesianStrength y j 1 (show Fin 4 from ⟨a.val+2,by omega⟩)=
      shellNullFrequency y*nullPolarization y a j := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cartesianStrength,shellNullFrequency,nullPolarization] <;> ring

theorem stress_null_contraction (F : Fin 4→Fin 4→ℂ)
    (ha : ∀μ ν,F ν μ= -F μ ν) :
    stress metricSignC F 0 0+stress metricSignC F 0 1+
      stress metricSignC F 1 0+stress metricSignC F 1 1=
      (F 0 2+F 1 2)^2+(F 0 3+F 1 3)^2 := by
  have h00 : F 0 0=0 := by have h:=ha 0 0; linear_combination (1/2:ℂ)*h
  have h11 : F 1 1=0 := by have h:=ha 1 1; linear_combination (1/2:ℂ)*h
  have hs0 : metricSignC (0:Fin 4)=(1:ℂ) := rfl
  have hs1 : metricSignC (1:Fin 4)=(-1:ℂ) := rfl
  have hs2 : metricSignC (2:Fin 4)=(-1:ℂ) := rfl
  have hs3 : metricSignC (3:Fin 4)=(-1:ℂ) := rfl
  simp only [stress,Fin.sum_univ_four,hs0,hs1,hs2,hs3,h00,h11,ha 0 1]
  norm_num
  ring

end F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal

#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.nullPolarization_orthogonal
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.null_strength_factor
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.stress_null_contraction


SOURCE AngularWeightedPlancherelR3.lean SHA256 d73b5bf251c03c8e9c870336376c105e34ef07fcf4231b6692931032e47438c6
import WeightedSchwartzPlancherelR3

/-! Angular Fourier first moment with its exact (2 pi)^dimension factor.
The raw angular integral is not silently normalized as an isometry. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.WeightedPlancherel
open MeasureTheory FourierTransform SchwartzMap Module
open scoped FourierTransform LineDeriv
variable {V H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

theorem weighted_forward_parseval (f g : 𝓢(V,H)) (m : V) :
    (∫x,(inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*inner ℂ (𝓕 f x) (𝓕 g x))=
      (-Complex.I/(2*Real.pi:ℝ))*∫p,inner ℂ (f p) ((∂_{m} g) p) := by
  have ht : (fun x : V=>inner ℝ x m).HasTemperateGrowth := by fun_prop
  have hp:=integral_inner_fourier_fourier f (∂_{m} g)
  rw [SchwartzMap.fourier_lineDerivOp_eq] at hp
  have he : (∫x,inner ℂ (𝓕 f x)
      (((2*Real.pi*Complex.I) • SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM H
        (fun x : V=>inner ℝ x m) (𝓕 g)) x))=
      (2*Real.pi*Complex.I) *
        ∫x,(inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*inner ℂ (𝓕 f x) (𝓕 g x) := by
    simp only [SchwartzMap.smul_apply,SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply ht,
      ←Complex.coe_smul,inner_smul_right,mul_assoc,integral_const_mul]
  rw [he] at hp
  rw [←hp]
  have hc : (-Complex.I/(2*Real.pi:ℝ)) * (2*Real.pi*Complex.I)=(1:ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    simp [Complex.I_sq]
  rw [←mul_assoc,hc,one_mul]

theorem linear_weight_dilation (F : V→ℂ) (m : V) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0<c) :
    (∫x,(inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*F (c⁻¹ • x))=
      (c^(finrank ℝ V+1):ℝ) • ∫x,(inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*F x := by
  have he (x : V) : (inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*F (c⁻¹ • x)=
      c • ((inner ℝ (c⁻¹ • x) m:ℂ)*F (c⁻¹ • x)) := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_left]
    push_cast
    rw [←Complex.coe_smul,smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp [hc.ne']
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [integral_smul,Measure.integral_comp_inv_smul_of_nonneg (volume:Measure V) (fun x : V=>(inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*F x) hc.le,smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [pow_succ,mul_comm]

def angularForward (f : 𝓢(V,H)) (x : V) : H := 𝓕 f ((2*Real.pi)⁻¹ • x)

theorem angular_weighted_parseval (f g : 𝓢(V,H)) (m : V) :
    (∫x,(inner ℝ x m:ℂ)*inner ℂ (angularForward f x) (angularForward g x))=
      (-Complex.I*(2*Real.pi:ℝ)^(finrank ℝ V))*
        ∫p,inner ℂ (f p) ((∂_{m} g) p) := by
  have hc : 0<2*Real.pi := by positivity
  unfold angularForward
  rw [linear_weight_dilation (fun x=>inner ℂ (𝓕 f x) (𝓕 g x)) m _ hc,
    weighted_forward_parseval,←Complex.coe_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]

end F1Fecho.WeightedPlancherel
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeightedPlancherel.weighted_forward_parseval
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeightedPlancherel.linear_weight_dilation
#print axioms F1Fecho.WeightedPlancherel.angular_weighted_parseval

/-! Bochner realization of all sixteen components of the same regular Maxwell
wave. This permits continuous tensor maps to pass through the actual integral. -/

namespace F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal
open MeasureTheory TGLExt.ImportedSQ
open ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016

def tensorDensity (h : H1) (y : MomentumCoordinates) : TensorValue :=
  fun μ ν=>profileDensity h μ ν y

def tensorWaveIntegrand (h : H1) (x : Spacetime) (y : MomentumCoordinates) : TensorValue :=
  wavePhase x y • tensorDensity h y

theorem profileWaveIntegrand_integrable (h : H1) (hh : RegularProfile h)
    (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    Integrable (fun y=>wavePhase x y*profileDensity h μ ν y) (orbitalMeasure 0) := by
  apply (profileDensity_integrable h hh μ ν).norm.mono'
  · exact (wavePhase_continuous_right x).measurable.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
      (profileDensity_measurable h μ ν)
  · exact ae_of_all _ (fun y=>by rw [norm_mul,wavePhase_norm,one_mul])

theorem tensorWaveIntegrand_integrable (h : H1) (hh : RegularProfile h) (x : Spacetime) :
    Integrable (tensorWaveIntegrand h x) (orbitalMeasure 0) := by
  apply Integrable.of_eval
  intro μ
  apply Integrable.of_eval
  intro ν
  exact profileWaveIntegrand_integrable h hh μ ν x

theorem profileWave_tensor_integral (h : H1) (hh : RegularProfile h) (x : Spacetime) :
    (fun μ ν=>profileWave h μ ν x)=∫y,tensorWaveIntegrand h x y ∂orbitalMeasure 0 := by
  ext μ ν
  rw [eval_integral (fun μ=>(tensorWaveIntegrand_integrable h hh x).eval μ)]
  rw [eval_integral (fun ν=>((tensorWaveIntegrand_integrable h hh x).eval μ).eval ν)]
  rfl

end F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal

import RealProfileMaxwellStressR4

/-! The off-diagonal coherent Maxwell kernel on the SAME regular H1.
Its diagonal is the already constructed real Maxwell wave. Multiplication by
the coherent overlap and extension to the regular Fock domain are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal
open MeasureTheory Filter
open TGLExt.ImportedSQ ChatgptAudit.WignerRapidityMeasure016

def coherentProfileWave (h k : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) : ℂ :=
  (Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)⁻¹*((starRingEnd ℂ) (lowerProfileWave h μ ν x)+lowerProfileWave k μ ν x)

def coherentProfileJet (h k : H1) (ρ μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) : ℂ :=
  (Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)⁻¹*((starRingEnd ℂ) (lowerProfileJet h ρ μ ν x)+lowerProfileJet k ρ μ ν x)

theorem coherentProfileWave_line_hasDerivAt (h k : H1)
    (hh : RegularProfile h) (hk : RegularProfile k) (ρ μ ν : Fin 4)
    (x : Spacetime) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ=>coherentProfileWave h k μ ν (x+u • spacetimeBasis ρ))
      (coherentProfileJet h k ρ μ ν (x+t • spacetimeBasis ρ)) t :=
  ((Complex.conjCLE.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    (lowerProfileWave_line_hasDerivAt h hh ρ μ ν x t)).add
    (lowerProfileWave_line_hasDerivAt k hk ρ μ ν x t)).const_mul _

theorem coherentProfileWave_antisymmetric (h k : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileWave h k ν μ x= -coherentProfileWave h k μ ν x := by
  unfold coherentProfileWave
  rw [lowerProfileWave_antisymmetric h μ ν x,lowerProfileWave_antisymmetric k μ ν x,map_neg]
  ring

theorem coherentProfileJet_antisymmetric (h k : H1) (ρ μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileJet h k ρ ν μ x= -coherentProfileJet h k ρ μ ν x := by
  unfold coherentProfileJet
  rw [lowerProfileJet_antisymmetric h ρ μ ν x,lowerProfileJet_antisymmetric k ρ μ ν x,map_neg]
  ring

theorem coherentProfileJet_bianchi (h k : H1) (hh : RegularProfile h) (hk : RegularProfile k)
    (ρ μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileJet h k ρ μ ν x+coherentProfileJet h k μ ν ρ x+
      coherentProfileJet h k ν ρ μ x=0 := by
  have h1:=congrArg (starRingEnd ℂ) (lowerProfileJet_bianchi h hh ρ μ ν x)
  simp only [map_add,map_zero] at h1
  have h2:=lowerProfileJet_bianchi k hk ρ μ ν x
  unfold coherentProfileJet
  linear_combination (Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)⁻¹*h1+(Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)⁻¹*h2

theorem metricSignC_conj (μ : Fin 4) : (starRingEnd ℂ) (metricSignC μ)=metricSignC μ := by
  unfold metricSignC
  split_ifs <;> simp

theorem coherentProfileJet_divergence (h k : H1) (hh : RegularProfile h) (hk : RegularProfile k)
    (ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    (∑μ : Fin 4,metricSignC μ*coherentProfileJet h k μ μ ν x)=0 := by
  calc
    _ = (Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)⁻¹*
        ((starRingEnd ℂ) (∑μ : Fin 4,metricSignC μ*lowerProfileJet h μ μ ν x)+
        ∑μ : Fin 4,metricSignC μ*lowerProfileJet k μ μ ν x) := by
      rw [map_sum,mul_add,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro μ _
      rw [map_mul,metricSignC_conj]
      unfold coherentProfileJet
      ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [lowerProfileJet_divergence h hh,lowerProfileJet_divergence k hk,map_zero,add_zero,mul_zero]

theorem coherentProfileWave_diagonal (h : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileWave h h μ ν x=realProfileWave h μ ν x := by
  unfold coherentProfileWave realProfileWave
  rw [realWaveProjection_apply]
  have ha : (starRingEnd ℂ) (lowerProfileWave h μ ν x)+lowerProfileWave h μ ν x=
      (2*(lowerProfileWave h μ ν x).re:ℝ) := by
    simpa only [add_comm] using Complex.add_conj (lowerProfileWave h μ ν x)
  rw [ha]
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)^2=2 := by exact_mod_cast Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤2)
  have hn : (Real.sqrt 2:ℂ)≠0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (by norm_num))
  push_cast
  field_simp [hn]
  linear_combination -(lowerProfileWave h μ ν x).re*hs

theorem coherentProfileWave_hermitian (h k : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (coherentProfileWave h k μ ν x)=coherentProfileWave k h μ ν x := by
  simp only [coherentProfileWave,map_mul,map_add,map_inv₀,Complex.conj_ofReal,starRingEnd_self_apply]
  ring

end F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.coherentProfileWave_line_hasDerivAt
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.coherentProfileWave_antisymmetric
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.coherentProfileJet_bianchi
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.coherentProfileJet_divergence
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.coherentProfileWave_diagonal
#print axioms F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal.coherentProfileWave_hermitian

/-! The pointwise coherent stress kernel built from actual regular profiles.
This kernel already satisfies Maxwell conservation and Hermitian swap. Its
extension to a Fock form and equality with the smeared Wick form need consumers. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1800000
noncomputable section
namespace F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal
open F1Fecho.MaxwellStress TGLExt.ImportedSQ

def coherentProfileStress (h k : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) : ℂ :=
  Complex.exp (inner ℂ h k)*stress metricSignC (fun α β=>coherentProfileWave h k α β x) μ ν

theorem coherentProfileStress_line_hasDerivAt (h k : H1)
    (hh : RegularProfile h) (hk : RegularProfile k) (ρ μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ=>coherentProfileStress h k μ ν (x+t • spacetimeBasis ρ))
      (Complex.exp (inner ℂ h k)*stressJet metricSignC
        (fun α β=>coherentProfileWave h k α β x)
        (fun ρ α β=>coherentProfileJet h k ρ α β x) ρ μ ν) 0 := by
  have hd (α β : Fin 4) :=coherentProfileWave_line_hasDerivAt h k hh hk ρ α β x 0
  have hr:=stress_hasDerivAt metricSignC
    (fun t α β=>coherentProfileWave h k α β (x+t • spacetimeBasis ρ))
    (fun α β=>coherentProfileJet h k ρ α β x) 0
    (fun α β=>by simpa only [zero_smul,add_zero] using hd α β) μ ν
  simpa only [coherentProfileStress,stressJet,zero_smul,add_zero] using
    hr.const_mul (Complex.exp (inner ℂ h k))

theorem coherentProfileStress_conserved (h k : H1)
    (hh : RegularProfile h) (hk : RegularProfile k) (ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    (∑μ : Fin 4,metricSignC μ*
      deriv (fun t : ℝ=>coherentProfileStress h k μ ν (x+t • spacetimeBasis μ)) 0)=0 := by
  simp only [(coherentProfileStress_line_hasDerivAt h k hh hk _ _ _ x).deriv]
  have hs:=stressJet_conserved metricSignC metricSignC_square
    (fun α β=>coherentProfileWave h k α β x) (fun ρ α β=>coherentProfileJet h k ρ α β x)
    (fun μ ν=>coherentProfileWave_antisymmetric h k μ ν x)
    (fun ρ μ ν=>coherentProfileJet_antisymmetric h k ρ μ ν x)
    (fun ρ μ ν=>coherentProfileJet_bianchi h k hh hk ρ μ ν x)
    (fun ν=>coherentProfileJet_divergence h k hh hk ν x) ν
  calc
    _ = Complex.exp (inner ℂ h k)*
      (∑μ : Fin 4,metricSignC μ*stressJet metricSignC
        (fun α β=>coherentProfileWave h k α β x)
        (fun ρ α β=>coherentProfileJet h k ρ α β x) μ μ ν) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro μ _
      ring
    _ = 0 := by rw [hs,mul_zero]

theorem coherentProfileStress_symmetric (h k : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileStress h k μ ν x=coherentProfileStress h k ν μ x := by
  unfold coherentProfileStress
  rw [stress_symmetric _ _ μ ν]

theorem stress_conj (F : Fin 4→Fin 4→ℂ) (μ ν : Fin 4) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (stress metricSignC F μ ν)=
      stress metricSignC (fun α β=>(starRingEnd ℂ) (F α β)) μ ν := by
  by_cases h : μ=ν <;> simp [stress,h,map_sum,metricSignC_conj,map_ofNat]

theorem coherentProfileStress_hermitian (h k : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (coherentProfileStress h k μ ν x)=coherentProfileStress k h μ ν x := by
  simp only [coherentProfileStress,map_mul,← Complex.exp_conj,inner_conj_symm,
    stress_conj,coherentProfileWave_hermitian]

theorem coherentProfileStress_diagonal (h : H1) (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileStress h h μ ν x=Complex.exp (inner ℂ h h)*realProfileStress h μ ν x := by
  simp only [coherentProfileStress,coherentProfileWave_diagonal,realProfileStress]

theorem coherentProfileStress_translate (a : Fin 4→ℝ) (h k : H1)
    (μ ν : Fin 4) (x : Spacetime) :
    coherentProfileStress (U1 a h) (U1 a k) μ ν x=
      coherentProfileStress h k μ ν (x-WithLp.toLp 2 a) := by
  simp only [coherentProfileStress,coherentProfileWave,lowerProfileWave,
    profileWave_U1,LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map]

end F1Fecho.MaxwellGlobal
